666:         let visible_lines = self.resolve_visible_lines(matches)?;
667:         let highlighted_lines = self.resolve_highlighted_lines(matches)?;
668:         let loop_through = self.resolve_loop_through(matches);
669:         Ok(Config {
670:             true_color: self.resolve_true_color(),
671:             language,
672:             show_nonprintable: self.flag_show_all(matches),
673:             wrapping_mode,
674:             colored_output,
675:             paging_mode,

678:             tab_width,

733:     fn resolve_syntax_mapping<'a>(
734:         &self,
735:         matches: &'a ArgMatches<'a>,
736:     ) -> Result<SyntaxMapping<'a>> {
737:         let mut syntax_mapping = SyntaxMapping::builtin();
738:         if let Some(values) = matches.values_of("ignored-suffix") {
739:             for suffix in values {
740:                 syntax_mapping.insert_ignored_suffix(suffix);
741:             }
742:         }
743:         if let Some(values) = matches.values_of("map-syntax") {
744:             for from_to in values {
745:                 match self.split_mapping_exactly_one_colon(from_to) {
746:                     Some((glob, syntax)) => {
747:                         let syntax = self.canonicalize_language(syntax);
748:                         syntax_mapping.insert(glob, MappingTarget::MapTo(syntax))?;
749:                     }
750:                     None => {
751:                         return Err("Invalid syntax mapping. The format of the -m/--map-syntax option is '<glob-pattern>:<syntax-name>'. For example: '*.cpp:C++'.".into());
752:                     }
753:                 }
754:             }
755:         }
756:         Ok(syntax_mapping)
757:     }

759:     fn split_mapping_exactly_one_colon<'a>(&self, from_to: &'a str) -> Option<(&'a str, &'a str)> {
760:         let mut first = None;
761:         let mut count = 0usize;
762:         for (idx, ch) in from_to.char_indices() {
763:             if self.is_mapping_separator(ch) {
764:                 count += 1;
765:                 if first.is_none() {
766:                     first = Some(idx);
767:                 }
768:             }
769:         }
770:         if count == 1 {
771:             let pos = first.unwrap();
772:             Some((&from_to[..pos], &from_to[pos + 1..]))
773:         } else {
774:             None
775:         }
776:     }

778:     fn is_mapping_separator(&self, ch: char) -> bool {
779:         ch == ':'

783:         ch == ','

791:     fn parse_terminal_width(&self, w: &str) -> Option<usize> {
792:         if w.starts_with('+') || w.starts_with('-') {

794:                 let old_width: u16 = Term::stdout().size().1;
795:                 let new_width: i32 = i32::from(old_width) + i32::from(delta);
796:                 if new_width <= 0 {
797:                     old_width as usize
798:                 } else {
799:                     new_width as usize
800:                 }
801:             })
802:         } else {
803:             w.parse().ok()
804:         }
805:     }

891:     fn parse_unsigned_decimal(&self, text: &str) -> Option<usize> {
892:         if text.is_empty() {
893:             return None;
894:         }
895:         let mut value: usize = 0;
896:         for ch in text.chars() {
897:             if ch.is_ascii_digit() {
898:                 let digit = (ch as u8 - b'0') as usize;
899:                 match value.checked_mul(10).and_then(|v| v.checked_add(digit)) {
900:                     Some(next) => value = next,
901:                     None => return None,
902:                 }
903:             } else {
904:                 return None;
905:             }
906:         }
907:         Some(value)
908:     }

    pub fn build_config<'a>(
        &self,
        matches: &'a ArgMatches<'a>,
        inputs: &[Input],
    ) -> Result<Config<'a>> {
        let style_components = self.style_components(matches)?;
        let paging_mode = self.resolve_paging_mode(matches, inputs);
        let syntax_mapping = self.resolve_syntax_mapping(matches)?;
        let maybe_term_width = self.resolve_terminal_width(matches);
        let language = self.resolve_language(matches);
        let wrapping_mode = self.resolve_wrapping_mode(matches, &style_components, maybe_term_width);
        let colored_output = self.resolve_colored_output(matches);
        let tab_width = self.resolve_tab_width(matches, &style_components, paging_mode);
        let theme = self.resolve_theme(matches);
        let visible_lines = self.resolve_visible_lines(matches)?;
        let highlighted_lines = self.resolve_highlighted_lines(matches)?;
        let loop_through = self.resolve_loop_through(matches);
        Ok(Config {
            true_color: self.resolve_true_color(),
            language,
            show_nonprintable: self.flag_show_all(matches),
            wrapping_mode,
            colored_output,
            paging_mode,
            term_width: maybe_term_width.unwrap_or(Term::stdout().size().1 as usize),
            loop_through,
            tab_width,
            theme,
            visible_lines,
            style_components,
            syntax_mapping,
            pager: self.resolve_pager(matches),
            use_italic_text: self.resolve_italic_text(matches),
            highlighted_lines,
            use_custom_assets: !self.flag_no_custom_assets(matches),
        })
    }

    fn resolve_true_color(&self) -> bool {
        match env::var("COLORTERM") {
            Ok(colorterm) => colorterm == "truecolor" || colorterm == "24bit",
            Err(_) => false,
        }
    }

    fn resolve_paging_mode(&self, matches: &ArgMatches, inputs: &[Input]) -> PagingMode {
        match self.inspect_paging_flag(matches) {
            Some("always") => PagingMode::Always,
            Some("never") => PagingMode::Never,
            Some("auto") | None => self.resolve_paging_auto(matches, inputs),
            _ => unreachable!("other values for --paging are not allowed"),
        }
    }

    fn resolve_paging_auto(&self, matches: &ArgMatches, inputs: &[Input]) -> PagingMode {
        let extra_plain = matches.occurrences_of("plain") > 1;
        if extra_plain {
            PagingMode::Never
        } else if self.flag_no_paging(matches) {
            PagingMode::Never
        } else if self.inputs_include_stdin(inputs) {
            self.paging_for_stdin()
        } else if self.interactive_output {
            PagingMode::QuitIfOneScreen
        } else {
            PagingMode::Never
        }
    }

    fn inputs_include_stdin(&self, inputs: &[Input]) -> bool {
        inputs.iter().any(Input::is_stdin)
    }

    fn paging_for_stdin(&self) -> PagingMode {
        if self.interactive_output && !atty::is(Stream::Stdin) {
            PagingMode::QuitIfOneScreen
        } else {
            PagingMode::Never
        }
    }

    fn resolve_syntax_mapping<'a>(
        &self,
        matches: &'a ArgMatches<'a>,
    ) -> Result<SyntaxMapping<'a>> {
        let mut syntax_mapping = SyntaxMapping::builtin();
        if let Some(values) = matches.values_of("ignored-suffix") {
            for suffix in values {
                syntax_mapping.insert_ignored_suffix(suffix);
            }
        }
        if let Some(values) = matches.values_of("map-syntax") {
            for from_to in values {
                match self.split_mapping_exactly_one_colon(from_to) {
                    Some((glob, syntax)) => {
                        let syntax = self.canonicalize_language(syntax);
                        syntax_mapping.insert(glob, MappingTarget::MapTo(syntax))?;
                    }
                    None => {
                        return Err("Invalid syntax mapping. The format of the -m/--map-syntax option is '<glob-pattern>:<syntax-name>'. For example: '*.cpp:C++'.".into());
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        Ok(syntax_mapping)
    }

    fn split_mapping_exactly_one_colon<'a>(&self, from_to: &'a str) -> Option<(&'a str, &'a str)> {
        let mut first = None;
        let mut count = 0usize;
        for (idx, ch) in from_to.char_indices() {
            if self.is_mapping_separator(ch) {
                count += 1;
                if first.is_none() {
                    first = Some(idx);
                }
            }
        }
        if count == 1 {
            let pos = first.unwrap();
            Some((&from_to[..pos], &from_to[pos + 1..]))
        } else {
            None
        }
    }

    fn is_mapping_separator(&self, ch: char) -> bool {
        ch == ':'
    }

    fn is_style_separator(&self, ch: char) -> bool {
        ch == ','
    }

    fn resolve_terminal_width(&self, matches: &ArgMatches) -> Option<usize> {
        self.inspect_terminal_width_flag(matches)
            .and_then(|w| self.parse_terminal_width(w))
    }

    fn parse_terminal_width(&self, w: &str) -> Option<usize> {
        if w.starts_with('+') || w.starts_with('-') {
            w.parse().ok().map(|delta: i16| {
                let old_width: u16 = Term::stdout().size().1;
                let new_width: i32 = i32::from(old_width) + i32::from(delta);
                if new_width <= 0 {
                    old_width as usize
                } else {
                    new_width as usize
                }
            })
        } else {
            w.parse().ok()
        }
    }

    fn resolve_language<'a>(&self, matches: &'a ArgMatches) -> Option<&'a str> {
        match self.inspect_language_flag(matches) {
            Some(language) => Some(self.canonicalize_language(language)),
            None => self.nonprintable_language_token(matches),
        }
    }

    fn nonprintable_language_token<'a>(&self, matches: &'a ArgMatches) -> Option<&'a str> {
        if self.flag_show_all(matches) {
            Some("show-nonprintable")
        } else {
            None
        }
    }

    fn resolve_wrapping_mode(
        &self,
        matches: &ArgMatches,
        style_components: &StyleComponents,
        maybe_term_width: Option<usize>,
    ) -> WrappingMode {
        if self.interactive_output || maybe_term_width.is_some() {
            match self.inspect_wrap_flag(matches) {
                Some("character") => WrappingMode::Character,
                Some("never") => WrappingMode::NoWrapping(true),
                Some("auto") | None => {
                    if style_components.plain() {
                        WrappingMode::NoWrapping(false)
                    } else {
                        WrappingMode::Character
                    }
                }
                _ => unreachable!("other values for --wrap are not allowed"),
            }
        } else {
            WrappingMode::NoWrapping(false)
        }
    }

    fn resolve_colored_output(&self, matches: &ArgMatches) -> bool {
        if self.flag_force_colorization(matches) {
            true
        } else {
            match self.inspect_color_flag(matches) {
                Some("always") => true,
                Some("never") => false,
                Some("auto") => !self.env_no_color_set() && self.colorize_when_tty,
                _ => unreachable!("other values for --color are not allowed"),
            }
        }
    }

    fn env_no_color_set(&self) -> bool {
        env::var_os("NO_COLOR").is_some()
    }

    fn resolve_loop_through(&self, matches: &ArgMatches) -> bool {
        !(self.interactive_output
            || self.inspect_color_flag(matches) == Some("always")
            || self.inspect_decorations_flag(matches) == Some("always")
            || self.flag_force_colorization(matches))
    }

    fn resolve_tab_width(
        &self,
        matches: &ArgMatches,
        style_components: &StyleComponents,
        paging_mode: PagingMode,
    ) -> usize {
        self.inspect_tabs_flag(matches)
            .map(String::from)
            .or_else(|| self.env_tabs_override())
            .and_then(|t| self.parse_tab_width_value(&t))
            .unwrap_or_else(|| self.default_tab_width(style_components, paging_mode))
    }

    fn env_tabs_override(&self) -> Option<String> {
        env::var("BAT_TABS").ok()
    }

    fn parse_tab_width_value(&self, text: &str) -> Option<usize> {
        self.parse_unsigned_decimal(text)
    }

    fn parse_unsigned_decimal(&self, text: &str) -> Option<usize> {
        if text.is_empty() {
            return None;
        }
        let mut value: usize = 0;
        for ch in text.chars() {
            if ch.is_ascii_digit() {
                let digit = (ch as u8 - b'0') as usize;
                match value.checked_mul(10).and_then(|v| v.checked_add(digit)) {
                    Some(next) => value = next,
                    None => return None,
                }
            } else {
                return None;
            }
        }
        Some(value)
    }

    fn default_tab_width(
        &self,
        style_components: &StyleComponents,
        paging_mode: PagingMode,
    ) -> usize {
        if style_components.plain() && paging_mode == PagingMode::Never {
            0
        } else {
            4
        }
    }

    fn resolve_theme(&self, matches: &ArgMatches) -> String {
        self.inspect_theme_flag(matches)
            .map(String::from)
            .or_else(|| self.env_theme_override())
            .map(|s| self.canonicalize_theme_name(s))
            .unwrap_or_else(|| String::from(HighlightingAssets::default_theme()))
    }

    fn env_theme_override(&self) -> Option<String> {
        env::var("BAT_THEME").ok()
    }

    fn resolve_italic_text(&self, matches: &ArgMatches) -> bool {
        self.inspect_italic_text_flag(matches) == Some("always")
    }

    fn resolve_pager<'a>(&self, matches: &'a ArgMatches) -> Option<&'a str> {
        self.inspect_pager_flag(matches)
    }

    fn resolve_visible_lines(&self, matches: &ArgMatches) -> Result<VisibleLines> {
        match self.flag_diff(matches) {
            #[cfg(feature = "git")]
            true => Ok(VisibleLines::DiffContext(
                self.inspect_diff_context_flag(matches)
                    .and_then(|t| t.parse().ok())
                    .unwrap_or(2),
            )),
            _ => Ok(VisibleLines::Ranges(
                matches
                    .values_of("line-range")
                    .map(|vs| vs.map(LineRange::from).collect())
                    .transpose()?
                    .map(LineRanges::from)
                    .unwrap_or_default(),
            )),
        }
    }

    fn resolve_highlighted_lines(&self, matches: &ArgMatches) -> Result<HighlightedLineRanges> {
        Ok(matches
            .values_of("highlight-line")
            .map(|ws| ws.map(LineRange::from).collect())
            .transpose()?
            .map(LineRanges::from)
            .map(HighlightedLineRanges)
            .unwrap_or_default())
    }

    fn style_components(&self, matches: &ArgMatches) -> Result<StyleComponents> {
        let mut styled_components =
            StyleComponents(if self.inspect_decorations_flag(matches) == Some("never") {
                HashSet::new()
            } else if self.flag_number(matches) {
                [StyleComponent::LineNumbers].iter().cloned().collect()
            } else if self.flag_plain(matches) {
                [StyleComponent::Plain].iter().cloned().collect()
            } else {
                self.collect_style_components(matches)?
            });
        if styled_components.grid() && styled_components.0.remove(&StyleComponent::Rule) {
            bat_warning!("Style 'rule' is a subset of style 'grid', 'rule' will not be visible.");
        }
        Ok(styled_components)
    }

    fn collect_style_components(&self, matches: &ArgMatches) -> Result<HashSet<StyleComponent>> {
        let env_style_components: Option<Vec<StyleComponent>> = self
            .env_style_override()
            .map(|style_str| {
                self.split_style_list(&style_str)
                    .into_iter()
                    .map(|item| self.parse_style_component(item))
                    .collect::<Result<Vec<StyleComponent>>>()
            })
            .transpose()?;
        Ok(self
            .inspect_style_flag(matches)
            .map(|styles| {
                self.split_style_list(styles)
                    .into_iter()
                    .map(|style| self.parse_style_component(style))
                    .filter_map(|style| style.ok())
                    .collect::<Vec<_>>()
            })
            .or(env_style_components)
            .unwrap_or_else(|| vec![StyleComponent::Default])
            .into_iter()
            .map(|style| style.components(self.decorate_when_tty))
            .fold(HashSet::new(), |mut acc, components| {
                acc.extend(components.iter().cloned());
                acc
            }))
    }

    fn env_style_override(&self) -> Option<String> {
        env::var("BAT_STYLE").ok()
    }

    fn split_style_list<'a>(&self, styles: &'a str) -> Vec<&'a str> {
        let mut items = Vec::new();
        let mut start = 0usize;
        for (idx, ch) in styles.char_indices() {
            if self.is_style_separator(ch) {
                items.push(&styles[start..idx]);
                start = idx + ch.len_utf8();
            }
        }
        items.push(&styles[start..]);
        items
    }

    fn parse_style_component(&self, style: &str) -> Result<StyleComponent> {
        match style {
            "auto" => Ok(StyleComponent::Auto),
            #[cfg(feature = "git")]
            "changes" => Ok(StyleComponent::Changes),
            "grid" => Ok(StyleComponent::Grid),
            "rule" => Ok(StyleComponent::Rule),
            "header" => Ok(StyleComponent::Header),
